$comment: The period windows the home page, the brand and model pages, the powertrain pages and the index list their figures over (src/lib/windows.ts). It holds no words: each window's words are the `win_<id>` entries of `words` in config/latest_month.json and config/answer_pages.json. `months` is the number of months ending with the newest month; `year_to_date` runs from January of the newest month's year to the newest month. A window's figure is the sum of its months, and its change is against the same months a year earlier. `canvas_period` is the id of the canvas period (config/dimensions.json, periods) a link to the canvas asks for; a window whose period the canvas lacks has its canvas link withheld. `default` is the window each surface opens on.
